points.name: High Inquisitor Fairbanks
points.note: Inquisitor in the Cathedral's upper hall, before the altar room.

points.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
points.note: Fights in the altar hall together with Whitemane's room behind him.

points.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
points.note: Joins after Mograine falls; she resurrects him once.

strategies.text: Casts a strong shadow/heal pattern; interrupt his heals and keep him off the casters.
Do not burn him down alone: Whitemane arrives mid-fight. Pull Mograine to the door side so she cannot reach the healer.
Kill Whitemane first when both are up; she revives Mograine once, so do not tunnel the dead one. Interrupt her big heal and her sleep.

notes: Mograine/Whitemane coordinates are only ~0.11 apart in y. The long entry corridor trash (Scarlet Monks, Chaplains, Abbots) has no sourced positions. uiMapID 438 inferred. Coordinates come from OpenMap (MIT), AllTheThings or web guides only; spots those lack are null. NeedRoll (GPL-3.0) was used only to cross-check; no values were copied.
